tools.name: firstpromoter_list_promoters
tools.description: List the promoters (affiliates) in the account, with search and id filters. GET /promoters.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_promoter
tools.description: Get one promoter's profile, campaigns and stats. Pass a numeric id, or set find_by to look up by email, cust_id, auth_token, ref_token or promo_code. GET /promoters/{id}.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_promoter_links
tools.description: List a promoter's referral links: the default link plus campaign and custom links. GET /promoters/{id}/referral_links.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_promoter_campaigns
tools.description: List the promoter-campaign records: each promoter's enrollment in a campaign, with the ref token and coupon. GET /promoter_campaigns.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_referrals
tools.description: List referrals (leads and customers) with filters for type, promoter, state and creation date. GET /referrals.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_referral
tools.description: Get one referral by its id, or by email, uid or username with find_by. GET /referrals/{id}.

tools.name: firstpromoter_create_referral
tools.description: Add a referral to a promoter campaign by email or uid (give at least one). Changes account data. POST /referrals.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_commissions
tools.description: List commissions and rewards across the account, with a search text and id filter. GET /commissions.

tools.name: firstpromoter_approve_commissions
tools.description: Approve pending commissions by id so they can be paid out. More than 5 ids run as an asynchronous batch: the reply has a batch id to check with firstpromoter_get_batch_process. POST /commissions/approve.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_payouts
tools.description: List payouts, filtered by status, campaign, promoter or payments batch. GET /payouts.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_payout_stats
tools.description: Get payout totals grouped by paid period, status or payout method. GET /payouts/stats.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_due_payout_stats
tools.description: Get the totals of payouts that are due now, optionally for one status or campaign. GET /payouts/due_stats.

tools.name: firstpromoter_list_promo_codes
tools.description: List promo codes on the account, optionally for one promoter campaign. GET /promo_codes.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_promo_code
tools.description: Get one promo code with its reward and promoter campaign. GET /promo_codes/{id}.

tools.name: firstpromoter_get_batch_process
tools.description: Get the status, totals and errors of one batch process started by a bulk action (for example approving more than 5 commissions). GET /batch_processes/{id}.

tools.name: firstpromoter_report_overview
tools.description: Get account-wide metrics (clicks, referrals, customers, revenue, commissions) over a date range, grouped by time. GET /reports/overview.

tools.name: firstpromoter_report_campaigns
tools.description: Get metrics grouped by campaign over a date range. GET /reports/campaigns.

tools.name: firstpromoter_report_promoters
tools.description: Get metrics grouped by promoter over a date range, with search. GET /reports/promoters.

tools.name: firstpromoter_report_traffic_sources
tools.description: Get metrics grouped by traffic source over a date range. GET /reports/traffic_sources.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: firstpromoter_get_promoter, firstpromoter_get_referral, firstpromoter_approve_commissions · Private data: firstpromoter_list_promoter_campaigns · Public sink: firstpromoter_get_promoter, firstpromoter_get_referral, firstpromoter_create_referral, firstpromoter_approve_commissions · Destructive: firstpromoter_approve_commissions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: firstpromoter_get_promoter, firstpromoter_get_referral, firstpromoter_approve_commissions · Private data: firstpromoter_list_promoter_campaigns · Public sink: firstpromoter_get_promoter, firstpromoter_get_referral, firstpromoter_create_referral, firstpromoter_approve_commissions · Destructive: firstpromoter_approve_commissions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
